MindMap.title: MindMap
MindMap.description: User created mindmaps with structure, styling and owner linkage.

id.description: The unique ID of the mindmap.

name.description: The descriptive title of the mindmap.

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp of when the mindmap was created.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of when the mindmap was last modified.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

nodes.description: Serialized list of all map node objects.

edges.description: Serialized list of all node link edges.

/users/{userId}/mindmaps/{mindmapId}.description: Secure isolation for personal user mindmaps.
